map.输入角速度 ω，求频率 f。: Input angular velocity ω to find frequency f.
map.成每秒转多少圈的频率值。: to how many turns per second (frequency value).
map.f = 6.283/(2π) = 6.283/6.283 = 1 Hz。即每秒转: f = 6.283/(2π) = 6.283/6.283 = 1 Hz. That is, 1 turn per second.
map.f = 1/T；频率是单位时间圈数，周期是一圈耗时，互为倒数。: f = 1/T; frequency is turns per unit time, period is time per turn, reciprocal of each other.
map.频率和周期、转速三者怎么换算？: How to convert among frequency, period and rpm?
map.周期 T=1/f，所以本例 T=0.4 s；转速（rpm）=f×60=150 r: Period T=1/f, so in this example T=0.4 s; rpm = f×60 = 150 rpm. The three describe the same thing, only in different units: Hz is "turns per second", rpm is "turns per minute".
